title: The Law Tome: an index of 1,116 named laws, principles and effects
description: A machine-readable index of 1,116 named laws, principles, effects, razors, paradoxes and fallacies. Every entry is traced to a primary source (2,489 source records) and rated for evidentiary weight as Empirical, Heuristic, Contested or Folk-adage. Includes 2,167 typed graph edges linking laws that echo, cause or contradict one another. Coined years span 1609 to 2014 across 20 fields. Companion dataset to https://conyso.com/lawtome/
